description: Defines the class 'ru_dummy_impl', a dummy radio unit implementation for performance and stability testing within the ocudu namespace. It includes methods for handling downlink and uplink data, and manages internal components like sectors, metrics, and timing.

classes.name: ru_dummy_impl
classes.description: A class implementing a dummy radio unit for testing purposes, managing sectors, timing, and data handling.

methods.name: get_controller
methods.description: Returns a reference to the radio unit controller.

methods.description: Returns a reference to the downlink plane handler.

methods.name: get_uplink_plane_handler
methods.description: Returns a reference to the uplink plane handler.

methods.name: get_metrics_collector
methods.description: Returns a pointer to the metrics collector if metrics are enabled.

methods.description: Returns nullptr; gain control not implemented.

methods.name: get_tx_time_offset_controller
methods.description: Returns nullptr; TX time offset control not implemented.
